Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- graphify: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

39	func (s *APIV1Service) checkMemoReadAccess(ctx context.Context, memo *store.Memo) error {
40		if memo == nil {
41			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
42		}
43	
44		// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
45		if memo.RowStatus == store.Archived {
46			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
47			if err != nil {
48				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
49			}
50			if user == nil || memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
51				return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
52			}
53		}
54	
55		if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
56			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57			if err != nil {
58				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
59			}
60			if user == nil {
61				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62			}
63			if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
64				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

70	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
71		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
74		}
75		if user == nil {
76			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
77		}
78	
79		memoUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.MemoId)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		create := &store.Memo{
85			UID:        memoUID,
86			CreatorID:  user.ID,
87			Content:    request.Memo.Content,
88			Visibility: convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility),
89		}
90	
91		// Set custom timestamps if provided in the request.
92		if request.Memo.CreateTime != nil && request.Memo.CreateTime.IsValid() {
93			createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
94			create.CreatedTs = createdTs
95		}
96		if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil && request.Memo.UpdateTime.IsValid() {
97			updatedTs := request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
98			create.UpdatedTs = updatedTs
99		}
100	
101		contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
102		if err != nil {
103			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
104		}
105		if len(create.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
106			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
107		}
108		if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
109			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
110		}
111		if request.Memo.Location != nil {
112			create.Payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
113		}
114	
115		memo, err := s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
116		if err != nil {
117			// Check for unique constraint violation (AIP-133 compliance)
118			errMsg := err.Error()
119			if strings.Contains(errMsg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
120				strings.Contains(errMsg, "duplicate key") ||
121				strings.Contains(errMsg, "Duplicate entry") {
122				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "memo with ID %q already exists", memoUID)
123			}
124			return nil, err
125		}
126	
127		attachments := []*store.Attachment{}
128	
129		if len(request.Memo.Attachments) > 0 {
130			if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
131				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
132			}
133	
134			a, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
135				MemoID: &memo.ID,
136			})
137			if err != nil {
138				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo attachments")
139			}
140			attachments = a
141		}
142		if len(request.Memo.Relations) > 0 {
143			if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
144				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
145			}
146		}
147	
148		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
151		}
152		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, nil, attachments, relations)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
155		}
156		// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is created.
157		if err := s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
158			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
159		}
160	
161		// Broadcast live refresh event (skipped when called from CreateMemoComment).
162		if !isSSESuppressed(ctx) {
163			s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
164				Type:       SSEEventMemoCreated,
165				Name:       memoMessage.Name,
166				Visibility: memo.Visibility,
167				CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
168			})
169		}
170	
171		if !isMentionNotificationSuppressed(ctx) {
172			s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, nil, "")
173		}
174	
175		return memoMessage, nil
176	}

178	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemosRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemosResponse, error) {
179		memoFind := &store.FindMemo{
180			// Exclude comments by default.
181			ExcludeComments: true,
182		}
183		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
184		if err != nil {
185			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
186		}
187	
188		if request.State == v1pb.State_ARCHIVED {
189			state := store.Archived
190			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
191			// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
192			if currentUser == nil {
193				return &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{}, nil
194			}
195			memoFind.CreatorID = &currentUser.ID
196		} else {
197			state := store.Normal
198			memoFind.RowStatus = &state
199		}
200	
201		// Parse order_by field (replaces the old sort and direction fields)
202		if request.OrderBy != "" {
203			if err := s.parseMemoOrderBy(request.OrderBy, memoFind); err != nil {
204				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid order_by: %v", err)
205			}
206		} else {
207			// Default ordering by create_time desc.
208			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false
209		}
210	
211		if request.Filter != "" {
212			if err := s.validateFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
213				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)
214			}
215			memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, request.Filter)
216		}
217	
218		if currentUser == nil {
219			memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public}
220		} else {
221			if memoFind.CreatorID == nil {
222				filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
223				memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, filter)
224			} else if *memoFind.CreatorID != currentUser.ID {
225				memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public, store.Protected}
226			}
227		}
228	
229		var limit, offset int
230		if request.PageToken != "" {
231			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
232			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
233				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
234			}
235			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
236			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
237		} else {
238			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
239		}
240		limit = min(limit, MaxPageSize)
241		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
242		memoFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
243		memoFind.Offset = &offset
244		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, memoFind)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos: %v", err)
247		}
248	
249		memoMessages := []*v1pb.Memo{}
250		nextPageToken := ""
251		if len(memos) == limitPlusOne {
252			memos = memos[:limit]
253			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
254			if err != nil {
255				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
256			}
257		}
258	
259		if len(memos) == 0 {
260			response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
261				Memos:         memoMessages,
262				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
263			}
264			return response, nil
265		}
266	
267		reactionMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
268		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
269	
270		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
271		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
272	
273		for _, m := range memos {
274			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, m.UID))
275			memoIDs = append(memoIDs, m.ID)
276		}
277	
278		// REACTIONS
279		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
282		}
283		for _, reaction := range reactions {
284			reactionMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(reactionMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
285		}
286	
287		// ATTACHMENTS
288		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDs})
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
291		}
292		for _, attachment := range attachments {
293			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
294		}
295	
296		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
297		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
298		if err != nil {
299			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
300		}
301		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
302		for _, memo := range memos {
303			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
304		}
305		for _, reaction := range reactions {
306			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
307		}
308		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
309		if err != nil {
310			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
311		}
312		for _, memo := range memos {
313			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
314			reactions := reactionMap[memoName]
315			attachments := attachmentMap[memo.ID]
316			relations := relationMap[memo.ID]
317	
318			memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, relations, creatorMap)
319			if err != nil {
320				if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
321					slog.Warn("Skipping memo with missing creator",
322						slog.Int64("memo_id", int64(memo.ID)),
323						slog.String("memo_uid", memo.UID),
324						slog.Int64("creator_id", int64(memo.CreatorID)),
325					)
326					continue
327				}
328				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
329			}
330	
331			memoMessages = append(memoMessages, memoMessage)
332		}
333	
334		response := &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{
335			Memos:         memoMessages,
336			NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
337		}
338		return response, nil
339	}

341	func (s *APIV1Service) GetMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.GetMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
342		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
343		if err != nil {
344			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
345		}
346		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
347			UID: &memoUID,
348		})
349		if err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		if memo == nil {
353			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
354		}
355	
356		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
357			return nil, err
358		}
359		if memo.ParentUID != nil {
360			parentMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: memo.ParentUID})
361			if err != nil {
362				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get parent memo")
363			}
364			if parentMemo == nil {
365				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
366			}
367			if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, parentMemo); err != nil {
368				return nil, err
369			}
370		}
371	
372		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{
373			ContentID: &request.Name,
374		})
375		if err != nil {
376			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
377		}
378	
379		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
380			MemoID: &memo.ID,
381		})
382		if err != nil {
383			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
384		}
385	
386		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
387		if err != nil {
388			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
389		}
390		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, relations)
391		if err != nil {
392			if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
393				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
394			}
395			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
396		}
397		return memoMessage, nil
398	}

400	// UpdateMemo updates an existing memo.
401	func (s *APIV1Service) UpdateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpdateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
402		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Memo.Name)
403		if err != nil {
404			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
405		}
406		if request.UpdateMask == nil || len(request.UpdateMask.Paths) == 0 {
407			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "update mask is required")
408		}
409	
410		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo: %v", err)
413		}
414		if memo == nil {
415			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
416		}
417	
418		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user")
421		}
422		if user == nil {
423			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
424		}
425		// Only the creator or admin can update the memo.
426		if memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
427			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
428		}
429	
430		update := &store.UpdateMemo{
431			ID: memo.ID,
432		}
433		var previousContent string
434		contentUpdated := false
435		for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
436			if path == "content" {
437				contentUpdated = true
438				previousContent = memo.Content
439				contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
440				if err != nil {
441					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
442				}
443				if len(request.Memo.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
444					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
445				}
446				memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
447				if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
448					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
449				}
450				update.Content = &memo.Content
451				update.Payload = memo.Payload
452			} else if path == "visibility" {
453				visibility := convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility)
454				if memo.ParentUID != nil {
455					parentMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: memo.ParentUID})
456					if err != nil {
457						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get parent memo")
458					}
459					if parentMemo == nil {
460						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
461					}
462					visibility = parentMemo.Visibility
463				}
464				update.Visibility = &visibility
465			} else if path == "pinned" {
466				update.Pinned = &request.Memo.Pinned
467			} else if path == "state" {
468				rowStatus := convertStateToStore(request.Memo.State)
469				update.RowStatus = &rowStatus
470			} else if path == "create_time" {
471				createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
472				update.CreatedTs = &createdTs
473			} else if path == "update_time" {
474				updatedTs := time.Now().Unix()
475				if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil {
476					updatedTs = request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
477				}
478				update.UpdatedTs = &updatedTs
479			} else if path == "display_time" {
480				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "display_time is not supported")
481			} else if path == "location" {
482				payload := memo.Payload
483				payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
484				update.Payload = payload
485			} else if path == "attachments" {
486				if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
487					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
488				}
489			} else if path == "relations" {
490				if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
491					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
492				}
493			}
494		}
495	
496		if err = s.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, update); err != nil {
497			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update memo")
498		}
499

505		}

518	func (s *APIV1Service) DeleteMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.DeleteMemoRequest) (*emptypb.Empty, error) {
519		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
520		if err != nil {

522		}
523		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
524			UID: &memoUID,
525		})
526		if err != nil {
527			return nil, err
528		}
529		if memo == nil {
530			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
531		}
532	
533		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
534		if err != nil {
535			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user")
536		}
537		if user == nil {
538			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
539		}
540		// Only the creator or admin can update the memo.
541		if memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
542			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
543		}
544	
545		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{
546			ContentID: &request.Name,
547		})
548		if err != nil {
549			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
550		}
551	
552		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
553			MemoID: &memo.ID,
554		})
555		if err != nil {
556			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
557		}
558	
559		deleteRelations, _ := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
560		if memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, deleteRelations); err == nil {
561			// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is deleted.
562			if err := s.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
563				slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo deleted webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
564			}
565		}
566	
567		// Delete memo comments first (store.DeleteMemo handles their relations and attachments)
568		commentType := store.MemoRelationComment
569		relations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID, Type: &commentType})
570		if err != nil {
571			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo comments")
572		}
573		for _, relation := range relations {
574			if err := s.Store.DeleteMemo(ctx, &store.DeleteMemo{ID: relation.MemoID}); err != nil {
575				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to delete memo comment")
576			}
577		}
578	
579		// Delete the memo (store.DeleteMemo handles relation and attachment cleanup)
580		if err = s.Store.DeleteMemo(ctx, &store.DeleteMemo{ID: memo.ID}); err != nil {
581			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to delete memo")
582		}
583	
584		// Broadcast live refresh event.
585		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
586			Type:       SSEEventMemoDeleted,
587			Name:       request.Name,
588			Visibility: memo.Visibility,
589			CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
590		})
591	
592		return &emptypb.Empty{}, nil
593	}

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91	
92		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memoComment.Creator)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
95		}
96		if creator == nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
98		}
99		creatorID := creator.ID
100		if memoComment.Visibility != v1pb.Visibility_PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID {
101			if _, err := s.createInboxWithEmailNotification(ctx, &store.Inbox{
102				SenderID:   creatorID,
103				ReceiverID: relatedMemo.CreatorID,
104				Status:     store.UNREAD,
105				Message: &storepb.InboxMessage{
106					Type: storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT,
107					Payload: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoComment{
108						MemoComment: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoCommentPayload{
109							MemoId:        memo.ID,
110							RelatedMemoId: relatedMemo.ID,
111						},
112					},
113				},
114			}); err != nil {
115				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create inbox")
116			}
117		}
118	
119		if err := s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID); err != nil {
120			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo comment created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
121		}
122	
123		s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, relatedMemo, "")
124	
125		// Broadcast live refresh event for the parent memo so subscribers see the new comment.
126		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
127			Type:       SSEEventMemoCommentCreated,
128			Name:       request.Name,
129			Visibility: relatedMemo.Visibility,
130			CreatorID:  relatedMemo.CreatorID,
131		})
132	
133		return memoComment, nil
134	}

136	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemoComments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemoCommentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse, error) {
137		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
140		}
141		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
144		}
145		if memo == nil {
146			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
147		}
148		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
155		}
156		var memoFilter string
157		if currentUser == nil {
158			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
159		} else {
160			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
161		}
162		memoRelationComment := store.MemoRelationComment
163		var limit, offset int
164		if request.PageToken != "" {
165			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
166			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
167				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
168			}
169			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
170			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
171		} else {
172			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
173		}
174		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
175		memoRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
176			RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID,
177			Type:          &memoRelationComment,
178			MemoFilter:    &memoFilter,
179			Limit:         &limitPlusOne,
180			Offset:        &offset,
181		})
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo relations")
184		}
185	
186		nextPageToken := ""
187		if len(memoRelations) == limitPlusOne {
188			memoRelations = memoRelations[:limit]
189			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
190			if err != nil {
191				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
192			}
193		}
194	
195		if len(memoRelations) == 0 {
196			response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
197				Memos:         []*v1pb.Memo{},
198				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
199			}
200			return response, nil
201		}
202	
203		memoRelationIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoRelations))
204		for _, m := range memoRelations {
205			memoRelationIDs = append(memoRelationIDs, m.MemoID)
206		}
207		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: memoRelationIDs})
208		if err != nil {
209			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos")
210		}
211	
212		memoIDToNameMap := make(map[int32]string)
213		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
214		memoIDsForAttachments := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
215	
216		for _, memo := range memos {
217			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
218			memoIDToNameMap[memo.ID] = memoName
219			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, memoName)
220			memoIDsForAttachments = append(memoIDsForAttachments, memo.ID)
221		}
222		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
223		if err != nil {
224			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
225		}
226	
227		memoReactionsMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
228		for _, reaction := range reactions {
229			memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
230		}
231	
232		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDsForAttachments})
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
235		}
236		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
237		for _, attachment := range attachments {
238			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
239		}
240	
241		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
242		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
245		}
246		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
247		for _, memo := range memos {
248			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
249		}
250		for _, reaction := range reactions {
251			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
252		}
253		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
256		}
257		var memosResponse []*v1pb.Memo
258		for _, m := range memos {
259			memoName := memoIDToNameMap[m.ID]
260			reactions := memoReactionsMap[memoName]
261			attachments := attachmentMap[m.ID]
262			relations := relationMap[m.ID]
263	
264			memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators(ctx, m, reactions, attachments, relations, creatorMap)
265			if err != nil {
266				if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {
267					slog.Warn("Skipping memo comment with missing creator",
268						slog.Int64("memo_id", int64(m.ID)),
269						slog.String("memo_uid", m.UID),
270						slog.Int64("creator_id", int64(m.CreatorID)),
271						slog.String("parent_name", request.Name),
272					)
273					continue
274				}

11	// SSEEventType represents the type of change event.

23	// SSEEvent represents a change event sent to SSE clients.
24	type SSEEvent struct {
25		Type SSEEventType `json:"type"`
26		// Name is the affected resource name (e.g., "memos/xxxx").
27		// For reaction events, this is the memo resource name that the reaction belongs to.
28		Name string `json:"name"`

36	// JSON returns the JSON representation of the event.

54	// SSEHub manages SSE client connections and broadcasts events.
55	// It is safe for concurrent use.
56	type SSEHub struct {
57		mu      sync.RWMutex
58		clients map[*SSEClient]struct{}
59		closed  bool
60	}

62	// NewSSEHub creates a new SSE hub.
63	func NewSSEHub() *SSEHub {
64		return &SSEHub{

69	// Subscribe registers a new client and returns it.
70	// The caller must call Unsubscribe when done.
71	func (h *SSEHub) Subscribe(userID int32, role store.Role) *SSEClient {
72		c := &SSEClient{
73			// Buffer a few events so a slow client doesn't block broadcasting.
74			events: make(chan []byte, 32),
75			userID: userID,
76			role:   role,
77		}
78		h.mu.Lock()
79		if h.closed {
80			close(c.events)
81		} else {
82			h.clients[c] = struct{}{}
83		}
84		h.mu.Unlock()
85		return c
86	}

88	// Unsubscribe removes a client and closes its channel.
89	func (h *SSEHub) Unsubscribe(c *SSEClient) {
90		h.mu.Lock()
91		if _, ok := h.clients[c]; ok {
92			delete(h.clients, c)
93			close(c.events)
94		}
95		h.mu.Unlock()
96	}

98	// Close disconnects all subscribed SSE clients.

100		h.mu.Lock()
101		defer h.mu.Unlock()
102		if h.closed {
103			return
104		}

114	// to avoid blocking the broadcaster.

129				// Drop event for slow client to avoid blocking.

132	}

39	func (s *APIV1Service) checkMemoReadAccess(ctx context.Context, memo *store.Memo) error {
40		if memo == nil {
41			return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
42		}
43	
44		// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
45		if memo.RowStatus == store.Archived {
46			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
47			if err != nil {
48				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
49			}
50			if user == nil || memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
51				return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
52			}
53		}
54	
55		if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
56			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57			if err != nil {
58				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
59			}
60			if user == nil {
61				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62			}
63			if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
64				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

70	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
71		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
72		if err != nil {
73			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
74		}
75		if user == nil {
76			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
77		}
78	
79		memoUID, err := ValidateAndGenerateUID(request.MemoId)
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		create := &store.Memo{
85			UID:        memoUID,
86			CreatorID:  user.ID,
87			Content:    request.Memo.Content,
88			Visibility: convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility),
89		}
90	
91		// Set custom timestamps if provided in the request.
92		if request.Memo.CreateTime != nil && request.Memo.CreateTime.IsValid() {
93			createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
94			create.CreatedTs = createdTs
95		}
96		if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil && request.Memo.UpdateTime.IsValid() {
97			updatedTs := request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
98			create.UpdatedTs = updatedTs
99		}
100	
101		contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
102		if err != nil {
103			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
104		}
105		if len(create.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
106			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
107		}
108		if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
109			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
110		}
111		if request.Memo.Location != nil {
112			create.Payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
113		}
114	
115		memo, err := s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
116		if err != nil {
117			// Check for unique constraint violation (AIP-133 compliance)
118			errMsg := err.Error()
119			if strings.Contains(errMsg, "UNIQUE constraint failed") ||
120				strings.Contains(errMsg, "duplicate key") ||
121				strings.Contains(errMsg, "Duplicate entry") {
122				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.AlreadyExists, "memo with ID %q already exists", memoUID)
123			}
124			return nil, err
125		}
126	
127		attachments := []*store.Attachment{}
128	
129		if len(request.Memo.Attachments) > 0 {
130			if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
131				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
132			}
133	
134			a, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
135				MemoID: &memo.ID,
136			})
137			if err != nil {
138				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo attachments")
139			}
140			attachments = a
141		}
142		if len(request.Memo.Relations) > 0 {
143			if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
144				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
145			}
146		}
147	
148		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to load memo relations")
151		}
152		memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStore(ctx, memo, nil, attachments, relations)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to convert memo")
155		}
156		// Try to dispatch webhook when memo is created.
157		if err := s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage); err != nil {
158			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
159		}
160	
161		// Broadcast live refresh event (skipped when called from CreateMemoComment).
162		if !isSSESuppressed(ctx) {
163			s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{

165				Name:       memoMessage.Name,
166				Visibility: memo.Visibility,
167				CreatorID:  resolveSSECreatorID(memo, nil),
168			})
169		}

171		if !isMentionNotificationSuppressed(ctx) {
172			s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, nil, "")
173		}
174	
175		return memoMessage, nil
176	}

178	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemosRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemosResponse, error) {
179		memoFind := &store.FindMemo{
180			// Exclude comments by default.
181			ExcludeComments: true,

183		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
184		if err != nil {
185			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
186		}

192			if currentUser == nil {
193				return &v1pb.ListMemosResponse{}, nil

204				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid order_by: %v", err)
205			}
206		} else {
207			// Default ordering by create_time desc.
208			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false
209		}

212			if err := s.validateFilter(ctx, request.Filter); err != nil {
213				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid filter: %v", err)

215			memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, request.Filter)

222				filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)

234			}

236			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
237		} else {
238			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
239		}
240		limit = min(limit, MaxPageSize)
241		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
242		memoFind.Limit = &limitPlusOne
243		memoFind.Offset = &offset
244		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, memoFind)
245		if err != nil {

247		}

249		memoMessages := []*v1pb.Memo{}
250		nextPageToken := ""
251		if len(memos) == limitPlusOne {

256			}
257		}

266	
267		reactionMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
268		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
269	
270		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
271		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
272	
273		for _, m := range memos {

278		// REACTIONS
279		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})

282		}
283		for _, reaction := range reactions {
284			reactionMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(reactionMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
285		}
286	
287		// ATTACHMENTS
288		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDs})
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
291		}
292		for _, attachment := range attachments {
293			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
294		}
295	
296		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
297		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)

302		for _, memo := range memos {

308		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)

310			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
311		}
312		for _, memo := range memos {
313			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
314			reactions := reactionMap[memoName]
315			attachments := attachmentMap[memo.ID]
316			relations := relationMap[memo.ID]
317	
318			memoMessage, err := s.convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators(ctx, memo, reactions, attachments, relations, creatorMap)
319			if err != nil {
320				if stderrors.Is(err, errMemoCreatorNotFound) {

322						slog.Int64("memo_id", int64(memo.ID)),
323						slog.String("memo_uid", memo.UID),

329			}

331			memoMessages = append(memoMessages, memoMessage)

401	func (s *APIV1Service) UpdateMemo(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpdateMemoRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
402		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Memo.Name)
403		if err != nil {
404			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
405		}
406		if request.UpdateMask == nil || len(request.UpdateMask.Paths) == 0 {
407			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "update mask is required")
408		}
409	
410		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
411		if err != nil {
412			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo: %v", err)

415			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
416		}
417	
418		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user")
421		}
422		if user == nil {
423			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
424		}
425		// Only the creator or admin can update the memo.
426		if memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
427			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
428		}
429	
430		update := &store.UpdateMemo{
431			ID: memo.ID,
432		}
433		var previousContent string
434		contentUpdated := false
435		for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
436			if path == "content" {
437				contentUpdated = true
438				previousContent = memo.Content
439				contentLengthLimit, err := s.getContentLengthLimit(ctx)
440				if err != nil {
441					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get content length limit")
442				}
443				if len(request.Memo.Content) > contentLengthLimit {
444					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "content too long (max %d characters)", contentLengthLimit)
445				}
446				memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
447				if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
448					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
449				}
450				update.Content = &memo.Content
451				update.Payload = memo.Payload
452			} else if path == "visibility" {
453				visibility := convertVisibilityToStore(request.Memo.Visibility)
454				if memo.ParentUID != nil {
455					parentMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: memo.ParentUID})
456					if err != nil {
457						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get parent memo")
458					}
459					if parentMemo == nil {
460						return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
461					}
462					visibility = parentMemo.Visibility
463				}
464				update.Visibility = &visibility
465			} else if path == "pinned" {
466				update.Pinned = &request.Memo.Pinned
467			} else if path == "state" {
468				rowStatus := convertStateToStore(request.Memo.State)
469				update.RowStatus = &rowStatus
470			} else if path == "create_time" {
471				createdTs := request.Memo.CreateTime.AsTime().Unix()
472				update.CreatedTs = &createdTs
473			} else if path == "update_time" {
474				updatedTs := time.Now().Unix()
475				if request.Memo.UpdateTime != nil {
476					updatedTs = request.Memo.UpdateTime.AsTime().Unix()
477				}
478				update.UpdatedTs = &updatedTs
479			} else if path == "display_time" {
480				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "display_time is not supported")
481			} else if path == "location" {
482				payload := memo.Payload
483				payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(request.Memo.Location)
484				update.Payload = payload
485			} else if path == "attachments" {
486				if err := s.setMemoAttachmentsInternal(ctx, user, memo, request.Memo.Attachments); err != nil {
487					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo attachments")
488				}
489			} else if path == "relations" {
490				if err := s.setMemoRelationsInternal(ctx, memo, request.Memo.Relations); err != nil {
491					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to set memo relations")
492				}
493			}
494		}
495	
496		if err = s.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, update); err != nil {
497			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update memo")
498		}
499	
500		memo, err = s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{
501			ID: &memo.ID,
502		})
503		if err != nil {
504			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo")
505		}
506		memo, parentMemo, memoMessage, err := s.buildUpdatedMemoState(ctx, memo.ID)
507		if err != nil {
508			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to build updated memo state")
509		}
510		if contentUpdated {
511			s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, parentMemo, previousContent)
512		}
513		s.dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects(ctx, memo, parentMemo, memoMessage)
514	
515		return memoMessage, nil
516	}

23	// SSEEvent represents a change event sent to SSE clients.

36	// JSON returns the JSON representation of the event.

54	// SSEHub manages SSE client connections and broadcasts events.

56	type SSEHub struct {

59		closed  bool

62	// NewSSEHub creates a new SSE hub.
63	func NewSSEHub() *SSEHub {

66		}

69	// Subscribe registers a new client and returns it.
70	// The caller must call Unsubscribe when done.
71	func (h *SSEHub) Subscribe(userID int32, role store.Role) *SSEClient {
72		c := &SSEClient{
73			// Buffer a few events so a slow client doesn't block broadcasting.
74			events: make(chan []byte, 32),
75			userID: userID,
76			role:   role,
77		}
78		h.mu.Lock()
79		if h.closed {
80			close(c.events)
81		} else {
82			h.clients[c] = struct{}{}
83		}
84		h.mu.Unlock()
85		return c

88	// Unsubscribe removes a client and closes its channel.
89	func (h *SSEHub) Unsubscribe(c *SSEClient) {
90		h.mu.Lock()

98	// Close disconnects all subscribed SSE clients.
